messages.text: We already get food stamps. Can my 3 year old also get WIC?

Your 3-year-old **likely** qualifies for WIC.

**Why**
- WIC serves children from their first birthday until their fifth birthday. Your child is in that group. ([USDA, 7 CFR 246.2](https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-7/section-246.2))
- Because your household gets food assistance (SNAP), you automatically meet WIC's income test. ([USDA, 7 CFR 246.7](https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-7/section-246.7))

**One more step:** WIC does a short health and nutrition check at the clinic. ([USDA, 7 CFR 246.7](https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-7/section-246.7))

**How to apply**
- Go to a local health department clinic, or call 1-800-DIAL-WIC (1-800-342-5942).
- Website: [Tennessee Department of Health WIC](https://www.tn.gov/health/wic.html)
- You could bring proof that you get SNAP. Ask the clinic what else to bring.

**Health coverage:** Your child also looks **likely** to qualify for TennCare/CoverKids. I only checked with the facts you gave me, so I didn't include your household's real income. For children ages 1 to 5, the limit is 142% of the poverty level. ([TennCare Eligibility Reference Guide](https://www.tn.gov/coverkids/coverkids/redirect-income-guidelines.html))
- Apply at [TennCare Connect](https://tenncareconnect.tn.gov/) or call 855-259-0701.

If you have other children under 5, or anyone who is pregnant or breastfeeding, tell me. They might qualify for WIC too. For free local help, you can dial 211.

This is a screening, not a decision. Only the state agency decides, and you can apply either way.
